title: Print window: frustrating lack of parameter saving
summary: The print window does not save print settings/parameters for subsequent operations. Each time I open the window, I have to reconfigure the paper type (e.g., A4) and duplex settings. The paper type selection does not adhere to standard printer driver specifications; it fails to display the paper types actually supported by the printer driver—for instance, when using a 4 x 6-inch label printer.
